title: Uncovering the anti-inflammatory mechanisms of compound Muniziqi granule against psoriasis by network analysis and experimental evaluation in vivo.
authors: Fu, Cuiying; Yang, Juexi; Lin, Xiner; Chen, Pu; Dai, Yan; Sun, Yan; Dou, Xiaoke; Wu, Yan; Zhang, Song
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方抗银屑病的抗炎机制，核心为体内药效与信号通路验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy of Compound Muniziqi Granule (MNZQ) and explore its mechanisms in an imiquimod (IMQ)-induced psoriasiform mouse model. METHODS: IMQ cream was applied to dorsal skin to induce lesions. Treatment groups received MNZQ by oral gavage at 1.8, 3.6, and 5.4 g/kg/day, or methotrexate (MTX, 10 mg/kg/week). MNZQ was chemically characterized by UPLC-MS/MS to profile its metabolites. The curated metabolite set was then used for network analysis and molecular docking. Predicted targets and pathways were evaluated by in vivo outcomes (PASI scores and H&E histology) and bench validation, including RT-qPCR (Il17a/Il22), flow cytometry (Th17, gammadelta T17), and Western blotting for STAT3, AKT, mTOR, and their phosphorylated forms. RESULTS: MNZQ significantly improved clinical and histological indices. As a hypothesis-generating step, in silico network analysis and molecular docking prioritized Th17 differentiation and the IL-17, JAK-STAT, and PI3K-AKT pathways. Consistent with these predictions, MNZQ was associated with lower frequencies of Th17 and gammadelta T17 cells in skin, spleen, and draining lymph nodes, and with reduced Il17a/Il22 transcripts in lesions and draining nodes (no clear dose-response). At the protein level, lesional skin showed decreased phosphorylation of STAT3, AKT, and mTOR. CONCLUSION: The findings indicate that MNZQ exerts anti-psoriatic efficacy in vivo, concurrent with decreases in gammadelta T17/Th17 cells frequencies and attenuation of the pro-inflammatory JAK-STAT3 and PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling pathways.
abstract_zh: 目的：评估复方木尼孜其颗粒（MNZQ）在咪喹莫特（IMQ）诱导的银屑病样小鼠模型中的疗效，并探讨其作用机制。方法：将IMQ乳膏涂抹于背部皮肤以诱导皮损。治疗组分别通过口服灌胃给予MNZQ（1.8、3.6和5.4 g/kg/天）或甲氨蝶呤（MTX，10 mg/kg/周）。通过UPLC-MS/MS对MNZQ进行化学表征，以分析其代谢产物。随后，将精选的代谢物集用于网络分析和分子对接。预测的靶点和通路通过体内结果（PASI评分和H&E组织学）及实验验证进行评估，包括RT-qPCR（Il17a/Il22）、流式细胞术（Th17、γδ T17）以及针对STAT3、AKT、mTOR及其磷酸化形式的Western blotting。结果：MNZQ显著改善了临床和组织学指标。作为假设生成步骤，计算机模拟网络分析和分子对接优先考虑了Th17分化和IL-17、JAK-STAT及PI3K-AKT通路。与这些预测一致，MNZQ与皮肤、脾脏和引流淋巴结中Th17和γδ T17细胞频率降低相关，并伴随皮损和引流淋巴结中Il17a/Il22转录水平下降（无明显剂量-反应关系）。在蛋白水平上，皮损皮肤中STAT3、AKT和mTOR的磷酸化水平降低。结论：研究结果表明，MNZQ在体内发挥抗银屑病疗效，同时伴随γδ T17/Th17细胞频率降低以及促炎性JAK-STAT3和PI3K-AKT-mTOR信号通路的减弱。
